data.one_liner: Code generator tool to make communication between Flutter and host platforms type-safe.
data.what_it_does: Pigeon is a code generator that replaces standard platform channels with type-safe generated code. It removes the necessity to manage strings across multiple platforms and handles generating Dart and native language bindings.
use_when: You want type-safe communication between Flutter and host platforms.
You want to avoid writing boilerplate platform channel code manually.
You need high performance communication using native interop (FFI/JNI) or platform channels.
avoid_when: You want to split generated code across separate public packages, which is strongly discouraged.
Targeting platforms where specific native interop features are unsupported and you cannot use platform channels instead.
strengths: Removes the need to write custom platform channel boilerplate.
Provides type-safety and eliminates string management across multiple languages.
Supports both traditional asynchronous platform channels and experimental high-performance native interop (FFI/JNI).
weaknesses: Breaking changes in generated code are common because it favors internal improvements over consistency.
Using Pigeon-generated code in public APIs is strongly discouraged due to inter-version compatibility constraints.
data.setup_notes: Add pigeon as a dev_dependency, create a .dart file outside 'lib' to define the interface, run pigeon to generate code, and implement the host-language bindings in your native projects.
